author: Dingugh
quote: GTA 6 has a beautiful open world with terribly optimized performance, a cringe, not funny, bland and boring story. GTA 6 is not a GTA game at all, it has zero humor which is a core element of the GTA franchise historically, its "funny" moments completely fall flat and don't stick at all. This game has disgraced its fan base and pop culture as a whole. I wish I were just nostalgia biased, but in reality I was actually extremely excited for GTA 6 as I've been a fan of the franchise since GTA San Andreas, but this game is obviously not meant to be traditional GTA anymore, its meant for a new audience, a sensitive "Cozy" game audience. This game resembles the Sims or animal crossing more than GTA.
